title: Motion by @samuel_uiux: I got tired of presenting motion work on static mockups, so I built Sw
notes:
I got tired of presenting motion work on static mockups, so I built Swivel. Drop in your design, set up the device, lighting and camera, and export a video mockup up to 4K. Right in your browser. The beta is live and free: https://swivelmotion.app

Designer: @samuel_uiux. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
